C3 [certain, derived]: Socrates is mortal.
  logic: mortal(socrates)

A1 [deductive]: C1, C2 => C3

  warrant: Universal instantiation of C1 at Socrates, then modus ponens with C2.
assumptions: Read 'All men are mortal' as a universal over the predicate man(x).
